'''Doll Gourds''' were a juicy [[Melon/Legends|melon-like]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] which was prized among the [[Scout/Legends|rangers]] and [[Spacer/Legends|travelers]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Consuming it would restore a person's energy. An experienced ranger with enough Doll Gourds could travel for long periods without [[Sleep/Legends|rest]]. If necessary, it could lend the needed strength to outrun and escape from the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] hostile wildlife.

==Behind the scenes==
[[W:c:swg:Doll Gourd|Doll Gourds]] first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
